messages:
Sam Ortiz: noticing reproducible rendezvous timeouts on multi-node TP jobs ~10-15m in. Seen in us-west-2 and eu-central on dedicated pools. All ranks stuck at barrier.
Liz Chen: can you paste the run id + config? any recent infra/kernel selector changes?
Sam Ortiz: run-2026-03-15-1142, TP=8 PP=1 seq_len=4096 micro_batch=2. We rolled a kernel-selector tweak last week to prefer fused fp16 allreduce for large tensors.
Jordan Patel: ok that selector change could change collective chunking. Any NCCL logs?
Sam Ortiz: snippet from rank3 NCCL around the hang:
```
[2026-03-15 11:54:08] NCCL INFO Channel 2: allReduce start
[2026-03-15 11:54:08] NCCL WARN Channel 2: missing packet seq=1024 from rank=6
[2026-03-15 11:54:10] NCCL INFO retrying AllGather
[2026-03-15 11:56:12] NCCL ERROR: aborting
```
Hema Rao: I ran a comm/compute sampler across steps. Short extract (ms):
```
step 4320: compute=175, allreduce=115, overlap=25
step 4355: compute=192, allreduce=610, overlap=0
```
Hema Rao: allreduce explodes and overlap disappears just before the timeout.
Liz Chen: interestingly cache metrics show a spike in KV prefix evictions at the same time. Could KV routing produce per-rank size skew?
Jordan Patel: if per-rank tensor sizes vary, a collective algorithm switch could misinterpret chunk counts and produce missing packets. We should try forcing algorithm to ring/tree to see behavior.
Mike B: deploy-bot: run-2026-03-15-1142 terminated (SIGTERM) -- auto-retry scheduled.
Sam Ortiz: mitigation tests: forcing old selector (disable fused-allreduce) on a 2-node repro made runs stable >30m. With new selector hangs at ~12m. Also disabling KV prefix cache extended stability (~40m) but didn't fully fix.
Jordan Patel: try environment flags: `NCCL_ALGO=ring`, `NCCL_NTHREADS=8`, and `NCCL_DEBUG=INFO`. Also tcpdump the interconnect to confirm packet shapes.
Hema Rao: hypothesis: KV cache warming creates skewed per-rank contribution sizes (prefix-heavy ranks), selector assumes uniform shard sizes when choosing fused allreduce with certain chunking -> chunk boundary mismatch -> missing packets -> retries -> rendezvous stall.
Liz Chen: triage actions:
- Sam: collect NCCL_DEBUG=INFO + tcpdump + env dump (WORLD_SIZE, RANK, MASTER_ADDR/PORT). Upload to /shared/triage/run-2026-03-15-1142.tar.gz
- Jordan: add lightweight per-rank chunk-size histogram immediately before each collective and log it to step trace
- Hema: add conservative guard to kernel selector to avoid switching algorithm when per-rank size variance > 10% (feature-flagged)
- Mike: roll back selector in dedicated pool as hotfix and confirm customer impact reduced
Sam Ortiz: uploaded logs: https://internal.storage/shared/triage/run-2026-03-15-1142.tar.gz
Mike B: rolling rollback flag to dedicated pool now; monitoring.
Jordan Patel: long-term: selector should consult per-step histograms and prefer deterministic collectives for skewed steps. Also add e2e test simulating rank-size variance and asserting no missing-packet NCCL warnings.
Hema Rao: I'll open a PR today with selector guard + added per-rank logging, feature-flagged. Will include unit/e2e tests.
Liz Chen: created ticket ENG-1728 on board (multi-node TP rendezvous timeout after kernel selector change)
deploy-bot: created ticket ENG-1728 for eng-runtime
Sam Ortiz: side note: spotted slight 95p latency increase for embedding queries overlapping selector rollout window. We'll correlate metrics once logs are in.
Liz Chen: good work. Keep updates here and paste any additional hangs from other configs.
